_note: jq and agentscan are fully mechanical and map straight from this schema. mcp-scan cannot: it discovers skills only when aimed at a directory that DIRECTLY contains skill folders (aimed at a target root it exits 0 reporting nothing, which a naive lane entry would record as a clean scan), and its findings array has been `issues`, `findings`, `results` or a bare array across versions. Both are mechanical but inexpressible here, so they live in the bundled mcpscan.py wrapper, which this lane then consumes as an ordinary JSONL tool. Keeping it agent-driven was the last thing holding ai-tools-runner on a bare Bash grant (BL-002).

synth.title: AI-tool config file is not well-formed JSON

tools.name: agentscan
tools._note: ships with the plugin, so it cannot be missing. A lane with a bundled tool has no `unavailable` state: the worst case is `partial` with every external tool skipped.

tools.name: mcp-scan
tools._note: mcpscan.py already emits the finding schema, so the map is an identity pass-through; it is spelled out rather than omitted so a field added upstream is a visible edit here.
